newsitem.title: USA: US Justice joins suit against Textron on contracts.
newsitem.headline: US Justice joins suit against Textron on contracts.

text.p: The U.S. Justice Department said Thursday it has joined a lawsuit against Textron Inc and its former division, Textron Aerostructures, alleging the defense contractor fradulently overpriced Air Force subcontracts for wings for the B-1B bomber.
It said it joined a so-called whisteblower lawsuit by William Manier, a former Textron Aerostructures employee, that had been filed in Nashville.
The lawsuit alleged that Textron failed to disclose its true labor costs when negotiating the price of two Air Force subcontracts.
The suit alleged the failure to disclose costs resulted in the overpricing of the contract by "tens of millions of dollars," department officials said.
The subcontracts were worth almost $500 million, they said.
